commands.command: echo '=== Checking each stash for dev.db with data ===' && for i in $(seq 7 20); do echo "stash@{$i}:"; git checkout stash@{$i} -- dev.db 2>/dev/null && COUNT=$(sqlite3 dev.db 'SELECT count(*) FROM Job;' 2>/dev/null) && echo "  Jobs: $COUNT" && git checkout HEAD -- dev.db 2>/dev/null; if [ "$COUNT" -gt "0" ]; then echo "  FOUND DATA in stash@{$i}!"; git checkout stash@{$i} -- dev.db 2>/dev/null; break; fi; done && echo '---' && echo 'Final check:' && sqlite3 dev.db 'SELECT count(*) as jobs FROM Job;' 2>/dev/null && sqlite3 dev.db 'SELECT title, company FROM Job LIMIT 3;' 2>/dev/null
commands.description: Iterate through stashes to find and restore dev.db with job data
